question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a black present, Bob has a green present, Claire has a white present, Dave has a blue present, Eve has a orange present, Fred has a purple present, and Gertrude has a brown present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Gertrude swap their gifts. Finally, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Claire has the
Options:
(A) black present
(B) green present
(C) white present
(D) blue present
(E) orange present
(F) purple present
(G) brown present
solution:
Gift colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (black, green, white, blue, orange, purple, brown)
1. Claire ↔ Gertrude: (black, green, brown, blue, orange, purple, white)
2. Dave ↔ Claire: (black, green, blue, brown, orange, purple, white)
3. Bob ↔ Fred: (black, purple, blue, brown, orange, green, white)
4. Bob ↔ Claire: (black, blue, purple, brown, orange, green, white)
5. Fred ↔ Alice: (green, blue, purple, brown, orange, black, white)
6. Fred ↔ Gertrude: (green, blue, purple, brown, orange, white, black)
7. Bob ↔ Claire: (green, purple, blue, brown, orange, white, black)
Claire has the blue present, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
